2123213715981885455.en_summary: Space Investor replies that everyone will end up renting compute to SpaceX at some point in the age of Orbital Data Centers.
2123213715981885455.zh_summary: Space Investor 回覆說在軌道數據中心的時代，每個人最終都會向 SpaceX 租用計算資源。

2123212558438134157.en_summary: (Reposted by @elonmusk) Wall St Engine reports Elon Musk says SpaceX aims to bring online over 1 GW of terrestrial AI compute per month by the end of 2027. Current pace is ~0.5 GW a month, equivalent to roughly 220,000 Nvidia GB300s plus CPUs, networking and cooling.
2123212558438134157.zh_summary: （由 @elonmusk 轉推）Wall St Engine 報導 Elon Musk 說 SpaceX 目標在 2027 年底前每月上線超過 1 GW 的地面 AI 計算。目前速度約每月 0.5 GW，相當於大約 220,000 個 Nvidia GB300 加上 CPU、網絡和冷卻。

ticker_notes.SPCX: aiming for over 1 GW AI compute per month by end 2027

2123212134175949267.en_summary: (Reposted by @elonmusk) KanekoaTheGreat reports Elon Musk predicts 100% of superintelligence compute will be in space, and says Tesla and SpaceX would probably be better together. Orbital compute will scale, Earth compute less than 0.4%.
2123212134175949267.zh_summary: （由 @elonmusk 轉推）KanekoaTheGreat 報導 Elon Musk 預測 100% 的超智能計算將在太空，並說 Tesla 和 SpaceX 可能一起更好。軌道計算將擴展，地球計算少於 0.4%。

2123211994924798424.en_summary: Fireside Alpha reports Elon Musk says SpaceX is bringing on about half a gigawatt of AI compute a month, roughly 220,000 GB300s, and will be over a gigawatt a month by the end of next year. Making good progress, power at power plant level is limiting factor.
2123211994924798424.zh_summary: Fireside Alpha 報導 Elon Musk 說 SpaceX 每月正在上線大約半吉瓦的 AI 計算，大約 220,000 個 GB300，明年年底將超過一吉瓦每月。進展良好，電廠級別的電力是限制因素。

ticker_notes.SPCX: half GW AI compute monthly, over 1 GW by end next year

2123210477954367708.en_summary: Fireside Alpha reports Elon Musk reveals over 30 people now have a Neuralink, some use it to feed themselves with a robot arm, and he's confident it will eventually let people with spinal injuries walk again. Neuralink is a private company focusing on Telepathy product.
2123210477954367708.zh_summary: Fireside Alpha 報導 Elon Musk 揭示現在超過 30 人有 Neuralink，一些人用它通過機械臂饋自己，他有信心最終能讓脊髓受傷的人再次行走。Neuralink 是一家私人公司，專注於 Telepathy 產品。
